title: Data-items Phase 2: evidence-scoped assignment (43/140 -> 60+)
description:
Phase 1 (#71) added token-aware PII aliases; line-level detection ~135/140 but scorecard recall stuck at 43/140 because hitsToDataItemFindings rolls all hits per data_item:{ruleId} into one finding, and assignOneToOne blocks findings that match multiple gold expectations (~57 collision misses).

Goal: raise data-items recall to 60+/140 without cratering precision (>=30%), no regressions on mentions/components/data-flows.

Constraints:
- Do NOT change gold
- Preserve intentional regression: data-item-jvm-username-multi-file must stay matched:false (one rolled-up finding cannot satisfy two same-key gold rows in fixture harness)
- Preserve: single rolled-up finding per data_item:key with multiple sourceLines (eval.test.ts lines 36-52)
- Measure vs pinned baseline at tests/fixtures/baseline/series-1-performance-baseline.json (6d241f8)

Investigate: evidence-scoped assignment, per-location pairing, or rollup refactor. PR #71 noted simulated 115/140 at 35% precision with per-line expansion but broke multi-file guard — find approach that satisfies both.

Worktree: /tmp/scanner-d26093-rollup on branch cursor/data-items-rollup from origin/develop (0fd2b5a).
